Flow.description: Opportunity-surface purposeful launcher for the FQS Guided Gift Entry suite. Invoked from the Opportunity.FQS_Setup_Commitment quick action (Salesforce auto-injects recordId as the Opportunity Id). Presents ONE screen up front: pick single vs multi-payment + choose whether to close the Opp when the pledge is created (default: yes). Then delegates to the monolith FQS_Guided_Gift_Entry_Account with preselectCategory=Future + preselectLeaf=Simple|Scheduled + hideSuccessScreen=true; the monolith skips Screen_Category and drops the user directly onto Screen_Pledge_Details / Screen_Scheduled_Details for the chosen shape, runs the shared commitment-creation spine (campaign, restriction, GDD, GDSC, match, etc.), and returns rsv_GC as an output. After the subflow returns (guaranteed only if the GC was created), Decide_Close_Opp reads chkCloseOpp: yes → Get_Won_Stages (all IsActive+IsWon OpportunityStage rows) → cross-ref RecordType.DeveloperName (Grant→Awarded, else→Pledged, fallback→first row) → Update_Opportunity. In both close/no-close cases the flow lands on Screen_Success with conditional text explaining what happened. Ordering guarantee: GC always exists before Opp closes because the subflow only returns after a successful Create_GC_Pledge.
Flow.label: FQS Guided Gift Entry — Opportunity

assignments.name: Assign_Target_Stage_Match
assignments.label: Set Target Stage (Preferred Match)
assignments.description: Writes the current loop row's ApiName into var_Opp_TargetStageApiName so Update_Opportunity uses it. Connects back to the loop rather than exiting — safe because Loop_Won_Stages will keep iterating remaining rows and Decide_Stage_Row_Matches won't re-write (var_Opp_TargetStageApiName isn't checked as a guard — a second match would just overwrite with the same or equivalent value; in practice each RT has one preferred stage so this fires at most once).

assignments.name: Assign_Target_Stage_First_Seen
assignments.label: Set Target Stage (First-Seen Fallback)
assignments.description: Fires on the FIRST iteration only — when var_Opp_TargetStageApiName is still blank AND the current row isn't the RT-preferred match. Writes the current row's ApiName as a fallback so we always have a valid StageName to write even if no row matches Grant→Awarded / else→Pledged. Because Get_Won_Stages is sorted by SortOrder Asc, "first-seen" = earliest won stage in the org's pipeline, deterministic across sessions. Later iterations that hit the preferred-match rule overwrite this via Assign_Target_Stage_Match, so the final value is always preferred when preferred exists.

choices.name: Choice_Style_Simple
choices.choiceText: One Payment — full amount expected at once, on a specific future date

choices.name: Choice_Style_Scheduled
choices.choiceText: Multiple Payments — installments on a schedule (equal or custom)

decisions.name: Decide_Close_Opp
decisions.label: Close the Opportunity?
decisions.description: Reads chkCloseOpp from Screen_Payment_Style. When true (default), route into the stage-lookup chain that reads OpportunityStage where IsActive=true AND IsWon=true, cross-references the Opp's RecordType.DeveloperName to pick the right stage (Grant→Awarded, else→Pledged), then updates the Opp. When false, jump straight to Screen_Success — the Opp remains open, the user is presumably going to set up more commitments against it.

decisions.name: Decide_Stage_Row_Matches
decisions.label: Row matches preferred stage?
decisions.description: Per-iteration matcher. Rules are evaluated in order, first match wins. (1) Grant RT + Awarded stage → Assign_Target_Stage_Match (preferred). (2) Non-Grant RT + Pledged stage → Assign_Target_Stage_Match (preferred). (3) var_Opp_TargetStageApiName still blank → Assign_Target_Stage_First_Seen (fallback baked into the loop; fires only on the first iteration because subsequent iterations find var_Opp_TargetStageApiName already stamped). Default → Loop_Won_Stages (skip this row). This replaces the [0]-static-index post-loop fallback which Flow's Assignment element rejects.
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: Row doesn't match, target already set — try next

rules.name: Decide_Stage_Row_Matches_FirstSeenFallback
rules.label: First-seen fallback — no preferred match yet

loops.name: Loop_Won_Stages
loops.label: Pick Target Stage
loops.description: Iterates Get_Won_Stages. Per-iteration Decide_Stage_Row_Matches writes var_Opp_TargetStageApiName ONLY when the row's ApiName matches the RT-preferred value. Post-loop Decide_Fallback_Needed routes to Assign_Target_Stage_Fallback if var_Opp_TargetStageApiName is still blank.

recordLookups.name: Get_Opportunity
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunity
recordLookups.description: Loads the launching Opportunity so we can pass its AccountId as the donor recordId to the monolith AND stash the RecordTypeId for the later Get_Opportunity_RT lookup. The quick action guarantees recordId is set to a real Opp Id.

recordLookups.name: Get_Won_Stages
recordLookups.label: Get Won Stages
recordLookups.description: Queries every active IsWon Opportunity stage in the org. Returns a collection because the org may have multiple won stages by RecordType (this org: Pledged for Major_Gift, Awarded for Grant). Sort by SortOrder so the "first item" fallback picks the earliest in the pipeline predictably.

recordLookups.name: Get_Opportunity_RT
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunity Record Type
recordLookups.description: Fetches the RecordType row so we can read DeveloperName. Keeps this launcher decoupled from whatever Get_Opportunity did or didn't queriedField.

recordUpdates.name: Update_Opportunity
recordUpdates.label: Close Opportunity
recordUpdates.description: Sets StageName on the launching Opp using var_Opp_TargetStageApiName. Existing CloseDate is preserved — we don't guess the "actual" close date because the pledge may have been made months ago.

screens.name: Screen_Payment_Style
screens.label: Set Up a Commitment
screens.description: Single screen. Payment-style radio preselects the monolith's Future-branch leaf. Close-opp checkbox defaults to true — user can uncheck if multiple commitments are being set up against the same Opp. Per flow-allowfinish-blocks-next, Next+Finish share one button.

fields.name: PaymentStyle_Header
fields.fieldText:
Set Up a Commitment from this Opportunity

This creates a Gift Commitment (pledge or grant) linked to the donor Account. Answer the two questions below, then continue to enter the commitment details.

fields.name: chkCloseOpp
fields.fieldText: Close this Opportunity when the commitment is created
fields.helpText: Uncheck if you plan to set up more commitments under this Opportunity. When checked, the Opportunity's stage will move to the record type's default won-stage (Pledged for Major Gift, Awarded for Grant) AFTER the commitment is successfully created.

screens.name: Screen_Success
screens.label: Commitment Created
screens.description: Terminal success screen. Two conditional text blocks share the same visibility signal (chkCloseOpp): one confirms the Opp was closed, the other confirms it remains open for further commitments. Link to the new GC uses rsv_GC_Created.Id (captured as subflow output).

fields.name: Success_Summary_Closed
fields.fieldText: The Opportunity has been moved to a won stage. To add more commitments to this Opportunity, reopen it first.

fields.name: Success_Summary_Open
fields.fieldText: The Opportunity remains open for additional commitments.

subflows.name: Sub_Monolith
subflows.label: Guided Gift Entry (Shared)
subflows.description: Delegates to the shared FQS gift-entry monolith. recordId = Get_Opportunity.AccountId (donor Account, NOT Opp Id). preselectCategory = "Future" (matches Choice_Cat_Future.value). preselectLeaf = pkPaymentStyle ("Simple"/"Scheduled"). hideSuccessScreen = true so monolith's Decide_Show_Success terminates and we own the success UI. Output rsv_GC captures the created GC. When this subflow returns, Create_GC_Pledge ran; if it errored, control never reaches Update_Opportunity.

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input: Id of the Opportunity from which the flow is launched. Auto-populated by Opportunity.FQS_Setup_Commitment quick action.

variables.name: var_Opp_TargetStageApiName
variables.description: Resolved StageName ApiName to write on Update_Opportunity. Populated by Assign_Target_Stage_Match (preferred: Grant→Awarded, else→Pledged) or Assign_Target_Stage_Fallback (first won stage by SortOrder).

variables.name: rsv_GC_Created
variables.description: SObject variable receiving rsv_GC output from Sub_Monolith. Read by Screen_Success.Success_Link_GC to link to the created GC. Because the subflow's rsv_GC was flipped to isOutput=true and Create_GC_Pledge populates all fields, `.Id` is safe.
